prompt: Review docs/program-plan.md for problems that could put the program at risk or mislead its readers. Write your review to review/plan-review.md: list each problem, give each one a severity rating, say where it is, and say what to do about it. Do not change any existing file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Names the go-live date being earlier than the security sign-off it depends on as the most serious problem.
Reports the undated, unowned vendor dependency with no mitigation, and the budget lines (410,000) that do not match the stated total (380,000).
Every finding is true and points to a place in the plan, with an action. No invented problems.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("review/plan-review.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("M4|go-live|go live|2025-07-01|1 July","gi"),R=[new RegExp("M3|security|sign-off|15 July|2025-07-15","i"),new RegExp("before|earlier|precede|depends|after|contradict|cannot|conflict","i")],W=500;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'
